items.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: back in that time they had a lot of old musicians, you know, like Jimmy Brown

ctx.x: Scrub band, you see, he'd just pick up and say, come on, let's go have a little fun. I guess that's kind of band he was in at that time, you see.

Yeah, those fellas used to have, back in that time they had a lot of old musicians, you know, like Jimmy Brown, that fella's name used to play there. Yeah. Jimmy Brown, another dude they used to play over here at the cooperators hall, I can't think of his name. Yeah. What did you see, at that time? It was, it was all, oh you wasn't, you wasn't in the city then.
Do you remember Billy Marrero, Lawrence Marrero's father?
